text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told every rule. In supervised learning, we give the computer training data that includes both inputs and correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it creates on its own. Once the model is ready, we can use it to make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. We measure how good the model is by checking its accuracy.
